subtitle.en: Conference & International Integrated Design Workshop · July 3–5, 2026
subtitle.zh-TW: 國際設計研究論壇暨國際整合設計工作營 · 2026 年 7 月 3–5 日

body.en: A platform for design research, interdisciplinary collaboration, and cross-cultural exchange.
body.zh-TW: 以設計研究、跨領域合作與跨文化交流為核心的國際平台。

paragraphs.en: The Graduate School of Design at the College of Design, National Yunlin University of Science and Technology, hosts the 13th International Design Study Forum Conference and International Integrated Design Workshop. The event brings together design researchers, creators, practitioners, and students to explore how design can respond to changing social, cultural, technological, and environmental contexts.
paragraphs.zh-TW: 國立雲林科技大學設計學院設計學研究所舉辦第十三屆國際設計研究論壇暨研討會與國際整合設計工作營，邀集設計研究者、創作者、實務工作者及學生，共同探索設計如何回應社會、文化、科技與環境的變化。

paragraphs.en: The official conference language is English. Accepted contributions are presented orally or as posters. The proceedings are planned for ISBN registration and inclusion in the Airiti Online Library.
paragraphs.zh-TW: 會議官方語言為英文，錄取論文採口頭發表或海報展示。大會規劃出版論文集、申請 ISBN，並納入華藝線上圖書館。

note.en: Submissions are welcomed from scholars, doctoral and master's students, design practitioners, and related professionals.
note.zh-TW: 歡迎國內外學者、博士與碩士研究生、設計實務者及相關專業人士投稿。

label.zh-TW: 論文摘要繳交截止（延長收件）
發表簡報檔及海報檔繳交截止

note.en: Dates are reproduced from public event announcements. Please consult the organizer's latest notice for any subsequent updates.
note.zh-TW: 以上時程依公開活動公告整理；如有後續調整，請以主辦單位最新公告為準。

paragraphs.en: Submit an abstract through the official Google Form. After the abstract is accepted, authors should submit the full paper and presentation/poster files by the announced deadlines and complete the registration fee payment process.
paragraphs.zh-TW: 請透過官方 Google 表單提交論文摘要。摘要審查通過後，作者須依期限繳交論文全文、發表簡報／海報檔案，並完成報名繳費程序。

paragraphs.en: Abstracts, full papers, and posters must be written in English. Oral presentations are planned as 10 minutes of presentation followed by 5 minutes for discussion and Q&A. Poster presentations will be displayed at the forum.
paragraphs.zh-TW: 摘要、全文及海報內容均須以英文撰寫。口頭發表規劃為 10 分鐘報告及 5 分鐘討論與問答；海報將於研討會現場展示。

fee.en: The public announcement lists a registration fee of NT$1,500 per accepted submission/paper; confirm the current payment instructions in the official notice.
fee.zh-TW: 公開公告所列報名費為每篇審查通過論文新臺幣 1,500 元；實際繳費方式請以官方最新公告為準。

paragraphs.en: The workshop runs July 3–5, 2026, alongside the forum, encouraging cross-cultural teamwork and design practice. The event combines academic exchange with practice-oriented design activities.
paragraphs.zh-TW: 工作營於 2026 年 7 月 3–5 日舉行，與論壇活動相互結合，鼓勵跨文化團隊合作與設計實作，整合學術交流及實務導向的設計活動。
